introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, gently tilt your head towards your left shoulder.\n\nInhale, return to center. Switch sides and repeat.
name: SIDE-TO-SIDE TILTS

tips.text: Please don't move your shoulders when tilting your head.
Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Exhale as you tilt to each side, and inhale as you return to center.

introduce:
Sit up nice and tall in the chair.

Put your left hand on your right knee and your right hand behind you on the chair.

Inhale, lengthen your spine, then exhale and slowly twist your upper body to the right. Hold for a few seconds.
name: CHAIR SPINAL TWIST RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please don't let your hips off the chair.
Please don't tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Sit up nice and tall in the chair.

Put your right hand on your left knee and your left hand behind you on the chair.

Inhale, lengthen your spine, then exhale and slowly twist your upper body to the left. Hold for a few seconds.
name: CHAIR SPINAL TWIST LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please don't let your hips off the chair.
Please don't tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Sit up nice and tall in the chair. 

Tuck your chin, and round your back as you exhale. Then take a breath in, and look up, trying to drive your chest out. 

Repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR CAT COW

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Inhale when you drive your chest out, and exhale when you round your back.
You should not feel tenseness in your shoulders or back.
This exercise works on your upper back and helps stretch your spine.

introduce: Take a deep breath and as you exhale, slowly curl your chin to your chest, draw your lower belly in and round your back.\n\nFold your body and press your entire palms on the floor. With every exhalation, move your chest and shoulders away from your thighs. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This pose helps to release tightness in your neck, shoulders, lower back, and hips.
